notes: Original source pixels preserved. Registration, clipping and palette variants are runtime rendering operations.

prompts.tops: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference is the Muse Bloom girl, used ONLY for painterly illustration style, garment proportions and relaxed elbows. Create an ORIGINAL transparent wardrobe sprite atlas, 1024x1536, EXACTLY 2 columns x 3 rows, each invisible cell 512x512, all 6 items completely separated with generous transparent gutters. No labels, no grid lines, no text. Clothes only, NO people, mannequins, skin, hands, heads, legs, shoes or shadows behind items. Fine warm contours and softly painted fabric shading matching reference. Light warm NEUTRAL ivory/taupe fabrics, preserving highlights, suitable for runtime color variants. Every top faces straight forward, sleeves follow naturally relaxed arms down and slightly out, elbows gently bent. Full torso with narrow waist. Six tops in reading order: (1) cream cable knit sweater with full-length sleeves; (2) ivory tailored blazer, visible lapels, with closed ivory inner blouse, full sleeves; (3) pale oatmeal hooded zip sweatshirt with drawstrings, full sleeves; (4) ivory delicate blouse with puffed short sleeves and small ribbon at modest crew neckline; (5) cream tailored sleeveless vest layered over ivory short-sleeve shirt, clearly closed modest neckline; (6) ivory Chinese mandarin-collar jacket with frog buttons and full sleeves. Each top occupies its own cell approx x40..470,y40..470 relative to cell; shoulder line at cell y90, narrow waist at y390, long cuffs at y465. Flat invisible wearer in the SAME pose as reference. No see-through fabric. Transparent alpha everywhere except garments.
prompts.dresses: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference Muse Bloom girl is STYLE and body proportion reference only. Create an original transparent 1024x1536 fashion-game sprite atlas, EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, six isolated dresses, each in invisible 512x512 cell. Fully separate cells with transparent gutters. No labels/grid/text/humans/mannequins/skin/hands/feet/shoes. Fine warm brown outlines, softly painted folds, modern illustrated style matching girl. Light warm ivory neutral fabrics for runtime tints. Front facing with level shoulders, narrow ordinary waist, hips fitting the reference. All dresses have a modest complete bodice and short sleeves, covering the same shoulder/upper arm area as the girl's original T-shirt. Six dresses in reading order: (1) youthful short-sleeve puff-sleeved A-line knee dress, subtle waist tie; (2) elegant satin midi dress with fitted short-sleeve bodice, softly flowing bias skirt; (3) classic pinafore knee dress with square bib over an ivory short-sleeve blouse, all combined in one garment; (4) formal evening gown with short cap sleeves and sweeping long skirt, delicate embroidery; (5) Chinese cross-collar hanfu-inspired two-piece dress with modest SHORT sleeves and broad pleated mamian-style long skirt, subtle brocade; (6) Chinese qipao midi dress with high mandarin collar, short sleeves, frog buttons and delicate floral embroidery, closed modest skirt without high slit. Within each cell crown of garment y30, shoulder line y45, sleeve ends y115, waist y170, hem y480. Each garment keeps its own natural length proportions but fills the cell height. True transparent alpha, no shadow/background or body silhouette. Original designs only.
prompts.shoes: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference girl is illustration style and FOOT POSE reference. Original transparent footwear atlas 1024x1536, TWO columns by THREE rows, 6 PAIRS. Each pair in its own 512x512 cell. Fine warm contour lines and soft realistic painted shading matching the girl's sneakers. No people, no legs, no skin, no labels or grid, no background or ground shadows. Front view looking slightly downward, toe boxes fully visible, left and right toes gently turned outward like reference. Light neutral warm ivory/taupe shoes for color variants. Reading order pairs: (1) classic Mary Janes with round toes and narrow instep strap; (2) elegant penny loafers; (3) lace-up ankle boots, not tall boots; (4) strappy summer flat sandals with visible soles and completely empty transparent openings, no feet; (5) elegant closed-toe low block heel pumps; (6) chunky platform sneakers with thick soles. Two shoes per cell, inner gap 50px, ankle openings at y160 and soles at y390 relative to each cell. Each pair centered. Exact transparent alpha between and around footwear. Entire shoes visible, no cropping.
